queries.alerts: SELECT * FROM alertas_emitidas WHERE symbol=? ORDER BY ts_ms
queries.signals: SELECT * FROM signals WHERE symbol=? AND ts_open>=? ORDER BY ts_open
queries.outcomes: SELECT * FROM outcomes WHERE symbol=? AND ts_open>=? ORDER BY ts_open
queries.rupturas: SELECT * FROM rupturas WHERE symbol=? ORDER BY ts_open
queries.rupturas_tf: SELECT * FROM rupturas_tf WHERE symbol=? ORDER BY ts_open
queries.log: SELECT * FROM analysis_log WHERE symbol=? AND ts_ms>=? ORDER BY ts_ms
queries.states: SELECT * FROM symbol_states WHERE symbol=? AND ts_ms>=? ORDER BY ts_ms
queries.candles_15m: SELECT * FROM klines WHERE symbol=? AND tf='15m' AND open_time>=? ORDER BY open_time
queries.log_span: SELECT min(ts_ms) first_ms,max(ts_ms) last_ms,count(*) n FROM analysis_log
